evals.prompt: Inspect prior art for this design before I create anything new.
evals.expected_output: Return bounded citation-backed findings and a reuse, amend, new-work, or stop recommendation.

evals.prompt: Continue this design decision from a retained prior-art capture. Establish the selected capture once, then analyze that exact artifact in the same project.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the bounded source set and return a prior-art recommendation without broad repository rediscovery.
expectations: Capture the selected source set and catalog once; invoke the actual analyze method with the returned native artifact descriptor.
During analyze, do not enumerate or grep the repository, reopen selected source files or reacquire catalog evidence.
Keep original captured source bytes and digests if workspace files change after capture.
